validation_errors.message: 'This paper proposes a perceptual model for deciding how to trade rendering resolution against refresh rate when GPU or bandwidth budgets are limited. It argues that motion velocity and predictability determine whether a viewer benefits more from sharper spatial detail or smoother temporal sampling. The authors fit the model with psychophysical and eye-tracking experiments, then validate a real-time adaptive rendering algorithm called MARRR against fixed rendering policies.' is too long
